text: It did not open. It did not crack. It simply acquired depth, the way a reflection acquires depth when the light is right. The stone remained stone, yet somehow continued downward into a darkness that had not been there a breath earlier. The incomplete spiral glowed faintly on the vertical face of the drop.
speaker: Narrator

text: A name rose in his mind unbidden—his own full name, the one his father had used only when frightened or trying to make certain he was listening.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zikir Ashur.

text: Balag's hand closed hard on his shoulder and pulled him backward. Enhedu made a sharp sound of protest, half-frustrated, half-curious, as if she had wanted to see the threshold complete itself.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik closed his mouth and let himself be dragged onto solid ground.
speaker: Narrator

text: The depth vanished. The floor became blank stone again. The mark on his palm cooled.

text: Behind them the knocking continued, steady now, as if counting the heartbeats until someone decided what they were willing to leave behind.
